caption: This tonkotsu broth, creamy beige and glossy, floats with noodles and green onions. In a white ceramic bowl with black rim, tender chashu pork and pale yellow menma sit beside a white ceramic spoon on a wooden table with warm brown grain.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle texture variations.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with visible fat marbling and slightly uneven surface texture.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy beige, glossy, with visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a soft, fibrous texture and irregular, curled shape.
White ceramic bowl with black rim and "Sugakiya" text, smooth surface, slightly chipped edge visible.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved bowl shape.
